strings.SGV_regional_unifier_DEF: the West Siberian Task Force Command
strings.SGV_WSB_forming_nation_category_desc:
'When one main thing ends, something new begins.'

Dmitry Yazov suffered defeat and is now in his grave as a result, whilst the regional state, the Black League, has been torn to shreds. Before it had even fully got back on its feet, our country was overthrown by traitors; they have had their way, for now...

In this catastrophic situation, there are still those driven by hatred and a thirst for revenge. Pastanogov's Task Force 'Bogatyr' in Zlatoust continues to fortify its positions, posing a threat to Chelyabinsk, which is controlled by traitors. And whilst that accursed Pavel Batov is busy isolating our Omsk and reinforcing the garrisons in Chelyabinsk, we must act. By crushing all of Batov's potential allies, and by proving the loyalty and effectiveness of Savintsev's 'Chernoligovtsy' in battles, we can once again unite Western Siberia under the promise of seeing the Great Trial through to the end.
strings.SGV_invide_yugra_desc: Soslanbek Apayev is a slippery character, like a cat with nine lives. Despite all the repression and persecution, the thieves have survived. Well then, Savintsev has a different approach to reforming them - instead of prison sentences, we'll take those thieves who surrender into custody and send them to the 'Redemption' Brigades, where they'll have no rights. There, the gangsters will be taught proper behaviour, discipline and, above all, loyalty; otherwise, they'll be disposed of.
strings.SGV_invide_ntg_desc:
“No matter how many innocent souls you give a Chekist, it's never enough” - this saying fits Meshik to a tee. His recent collaboration with the Black League was rewarded with nothing more than a slap on the wrist, comparable to a blister or a rash on the skin.

An unexpected mistake contributed to the premature collapse of our League, so there will be no mercy for him. Our allies from Zlatoust will help us to ensure justice is done and to punish the Chekists and the local NKVD for their betrayal of the Motherland.
strings.SGV_invide_vorkuta_desc: In Vorkutlag, and indeed throughout the region, prisoners have criminally seized power. They are no better than their counterparts, the disorganised bandits of Yugra. Despite this sense of déjà vu, we will under no circumstances forgive that scoundrel Viktor Kolesnikov and his reprisals against the Black League's guards. We will respond in kind, with physical reprisals against all representatives of his regime.
strings.SGV_invide_surgut_desc: To our surprise, the self-proclaimed Government of Surgut is led by a civilian administration, which is weak and ineffective. Their leader, Valentin Shashin, is a true sycophant who survives thanks to deals and agreements with other regional military commanders. The potential threat from the north must be crushed on the battlefield as soon as possible if we do not wish to fight on two fronts.
strings.SGV_consolidate_control_over_the_northea: Consolidate Our Rule in the North-Eastern Urals
strings.SGV_countdown_to_the_ash_being_lit: Countdown to the Ash Being Lit
strings.SGV_countdown_to_the_ash_being_lit_desc:
Dozens of kilometres away, along the vague line of demarcation in the east, lie the hostile rebel forces of Pavel Batov. This scoundrel has deliberately cut us off from our home city of Omsk, seeking to wear down and starve our forces through a lack of food.

We can play this game to our advantage if we act as quickly as possible. By capturing the Nizhny Tagil region, we will secure a route to our allies in the prosperous city of Zlatoust, which will resolve our food supply issues. Moreover, following this operation, we will cut off the transport link between Western Russia and the eastern traitors, which may delay the resumption of full-scale fighting for a while.

However, none of the generals are in any doubt: if hostilities do not resume this year, they will begin next year. The only question is, who will be the first to launch the attack?
strings.SGV_countdown_to_the_ash_being_lit_trigg: We are ready for the final showdown over Western Siberia to resume
strings.SGV_national_redoubt_program_category_de:
After much speculation by the leadership of the League about the nature of the Great Trial that looms ever on the horizon, we've come to understand the inevitable certainty that the war shall be nuclear in nature.

If Russia is to survive the German hellfire then we'll need to invest in the greatest network of underground bunkers the world has ever known.

Should this paramount objective be achieved, alongside the conduct of the Great Trial, our command, our soldiers, and the ideologically loyal population must endure an apocalypse. Although this will indeed take a great deal of time and resources, it will save everything for which we have shed and will continue to shed our own blood - a world free from the Teutons, and with Russia ruled by the Glavkovverh of the Black League. But we must ensure that the REDOUBTS COVERAGE LEVEL across the entire country exceeds 90%. Otherwise, we won't be able save our Motherland after the nuclear apocalypse.
--------------
REDOUBTS COVERAGE LEVEL = {SGV_national_redoubt_program}%
strings.SGV_national_redoubt_program_plan: Draw Up a Plan of the Redoubts
strings.SGV_construct_nizhny_tagil_bunkers: Assemble the Redoubt in Nizhny Tagil
strings.SGV_construct_amur_bunkers: Assemble the Redoubt along the Amur River
strings.SGV_national_redoubt_program_info_tt: Our nationwide level coverage of redoubts shall increase by 4%.
strings.SGV_no_loot_tt: We're currently completely out of loot
strings.SGV_ready_to_conquest_tt: The chains of command have been established and the troops have been placed on combat alert.
strings.SGV_consolidate_control_over_the_northea: ...The time has come to settle the score.
All our non-nationalised states will be immediately cored.
Having achieved our aims wherever possible, we are practically ready to take over the whole of Western Siberia, but first...
strings.SGV_new_glakoverkh_tt: Pastanogov is driven by a hatred that clouds his mind, and he lacks the leadership skills required to succeed in the Great Trial. Only with Savintsev as Glakoverkh, the Task Force 'Bogatyr' will be able to carry out its plans. Following this agreement, they will agree to peaceful integration in the future.
strings.SGV_inviding_neighbor_tt: Our country hasn't launched a new military campaign
strings.SGV_new_redemptive_brigade_tt: The residents of Saranpaul must take up arms, as their participation in forthcoming military operations as part of the newly formed Redemption Brigade is compulsory.
